title: Hold Fast Brewing
venue_description:
Hold Fast Brewing - Community-Centric Jazz Destination

Hold Fast Brewing is the only all-female-owned microbrewery in southwest Missouri, founded by sisters Carol and Susan McLeod in honor of their father's legacy. Located in historic downtown Springfield in a converted fire station, the brewery has become renowned for hosting exceptional live jazz performances.

Music Programming

Every Tuesday evening from 7-9 PM, Hold Fast hosts live jazz with no cover charge. The venue features rotating jazz lineups including The Brueggemann Gouge Jazz Band with Ladies of Jazz vocalists and MOJO Lite, a seven-piece ensemble from the Missouri Jazz Orchestra. The Tuesday night programming draws 100-200 jazz enthusiasts weekly and has been a consistent staple for several years.

Craft Beer Selection

Hand-crafted beers are brewed on-site by Brew Master Susan McLeod. The selection includes traditional styles and creative seasonal offerings, plus non-alcoholic options and craft ciders. The brewery also features adult slushies (Zamboozy) and canned cocktails for diverse preferences.

Venue Amenities

The converted fire station features spacious indoor seating and outdoor patio areas. Daily rotating food trucks provide dining options from BBQ to Thai to gourmet pizza. The relaxed, welcoming atmosphere encourages community gathering and conversation. Games and entertainment complement the live music experience. The location is dog-friendly and emphasizes accessibility and inclusivity.

Community Impact

Beyond music, Hold Fast actively supports non-profits and community organizations through fundraising efforts. The brewery has become a cultural hub celebrating local talent and fostering connection within the Springfield music community.

title: Where House Bar
venue_description:
Where House Bar - Modern Craft Cocktail & Live Music Venue

Where House Bar is a contemporary craft cocktail establishment located within the Metro Eats Farmers Market and Food Truck Park. The bar has been designed by the award-winning Mossinghoff Collective to reflect the hip sensibilities of west Springfield while honoring the city's musical heritage.

Live Music & Open Mic Programming

Every Tuesday from 6:30-9:30 PM, the venue hosts open mic and jam sessions under the JAM HOUSE banner. The program welcomes musicians of all skill levels and genres including rock, blues, alternative, and experimental music. Sign-ups begin at 6:30 PM. The venue also hosts other live music performances and jazz acts throughout the week.

Craft Cocktails & Beverages

Grand Marnier's Caribbean Bartender of the Year winner J.T. Thomas leads the cocktail program, offering both classic interpretations and innovative new drinks. Draft taps feature the best of Ozarks breweries including Springfield Brewing Co. and Mother's Brewing. The bar also serves craft wines and non-alcoholic options.

Venue Design & Atmosphere

The spacious interior features large overhead garage doors that open during mild weather, creating a seamless indoor-outdoor experience with fresh air and natural light. Plenty of outdoor seating and lawn games complement the main bar area. Multiple large screens allow viewing of live events. The location within the food truck park provides convenient dining from various vendors.

Music Scene Participation

Where House Bar is recognized by local media and the Springfield Convention & Visitors Bureau as a key venue in the city's live music landscape. The venue supports both established and emerging local musicians through regular programming and feature performances.
location: 2463 W Sunshine Street Suite 120, Springfield, MO 65807

title: Tie & Timber Beer Co.
venue_description:
Tie & Timber Beer Co. - Historic Craft Beer & Live Music Venue

Tie & Timber Beer Co. is located in the historic Pickwick Place business district in a building with deep Springfield roots. Originally constructed as a lumberyard in 1918, the building was transformed into a premium craft brewery producing fresh hand-crafted beers in small batches.

Live Music Programming

The brewery hosts live music every Friday and Saturday starting at 7:30 PM and features Hump Day Music on Wednesday evenings. Musical programming includes folk, rock, acoustic, and tribute performances from local and regional artists. The spacious beer garden and patio provide an ideal setting for enjoying live performances year-round.

Craft Beer Selection

With 18 beers on tap, Tie & Timber offers a diverse selection of hand-crafted ales ranging from traditional and approachable styles to creative and adventurous offerings. Small-batch brewing ensures fresh beer and allows the brewery to respond quickly to craft beer enthusiast preferences. The brewery also offers hand-crafted cocktails.

Venue Experience

The expansive beer garden and terraced patio create a relaxed community atmosphere. The venue is pet-friendly and family-friendly with a casual atmosphere. While no food menu is offered, guests are welcome to bring their own or order from local delivery services. Games and outdoor entertainment complement the live music experience.

Community Events

Tie & Timber regularly celebrates local music with festivals throughout the year. The brewery participates in the 417 Brewery Bus Tour and hosts special events and performances from touring and local artists. The intimate venue size creates an ideal setting for both established and emerging musicians.

title: Mother's Brewing Company
venue_description:
Mother's Brewing Company - Springfield's Largest Craft Brewery

Mother's Brewing Company is Springfield's largest craft brewery, housed in a historic building that was formerly a Butternut bread bakery owned by Hostess Brands. Founded by entrepreneur Jeff Schrag in 2010 with completion in 2011, the brewery has become a major community hub and was voted Best Microbrewery in Mid-Missouri.

Music & Events Programming

Mother's hosts regular live music events including First Fridays featuring art and musicians, monthly movie nights in the expansive backyard, and two major annual festivals. Mother's Day Fest occurs the Saturday following Mother's Day and Oktoberfest happens the second Saturday in September. Both festivals feature local food vendors, craft beers, and live music performances.

Craft Beer Portfolio

The brewery crafts innovative beers including seasonal offerings and signature styles like Sunshine Chugsucker and Imperial Grind #1 (coffee imperial stout). The diverse selection ranges from traditional styles to experimental and creative brews. Hard seltzers and ciders provide non-beer options. Saturday brewery tours include tastings of four featured beers.

Expansive Venue Space

The building includes a spacious tasting room, expansive outdoor beer garden with playground for children, and large backyard area. The brewery is pet-friendly and family-friendly with multiple entertainment options including games and activities. Food trucks regularly operate on-site providing diverse dining options from gourmet to casual fare.

Community Impact

Mother's is committed to supporting the local community and hosts fundraising events for non-profit organizations. The brewery's size, multiple spaces, and programming make it a major cultural venue in downtown Springfield. It continues to be a gathering place for friends, family, and community celebrations.
